text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=embeddings-backend (error-rate > 15%) — https://redwood.pagerduty.com/alerts/P12345 

pagerbot: Auto-ack pending. Current on-call: chris (primary), raj (secondary). If no ack within 2m, will escalate.

chris: acked — looking. grabbing logs now. anyone noticed any recent deploys? :wave:

emma: not from platform side. last deploy to embeddings was ~3h ago, small config tweak. i'm on call for infra but can help with metrics if you want.

chris: thanks. first glance — 5xxs coming from model shard g4-3 in eu-west-1, timeout spikes from grpc pool. past 10m qps -> ~1200.

sofia: customer-impact: spike corresponds to increased SLO error for realtime embeddings. CS alert queued; approx 12 customers with >50% failed embeddings in last 5m. tagging tier: mid/large.

raj: assigning to me for mitigation if chris needs to triage deeper. i'll scale up inference pool and flip routing to fallback variant. executing autoscale now: 
```
# increase pool by 3 nodes
infractl scale embeddings-pool --region eu-west-1 --count +3 --reason "pd page: spike"
```

chris: thanks raj. i'm pulling full traces and requesting core dumps from affected pods. running quick probe: 
```
kubectl logs -l app=embeds -n prod --tail=200 | grep "grpc timeout" | wc -l
```

incident-bot: Note: runbook for embeddings-backend -> /runbooks/embeddings-backend.md (steps 1-6). Recommend step 3 (evict and restart unhealthy pods) if autoscale doesn't reduce 5xxs within 60s.

emma: i'm checking upstream KV cache latency. if cache tail latency is bad, that can amplify grpc timeouts. running `redis-cli --latency -h cache-eu` now.

chris: confirmed elevated cache p50 -> 45ms (normal ~8ms). looks correlated. raj hold on scaling — maybe restart cache nodes first.

raj: ok switching plan. restarting two cache nodes. bumping fallback routing concurrently. will post status.

pagerbot: chris acknowledged at 1736000015. raj became active at 1736000050.

sofia: update to CS: posting incident banner to customers impacted list and marking potential degradation. cc @support-team.

emma: cache restart initiated: `infractl restart cache-eu --count 2` — ETA ~40s.

chris: fine-grained update: traces show a hot key causing heavy serialization on cache. adding muted rule to avoid spam alerts: 
```
alertctl mute embeddings-cache-hotkey --duration 1h --reason "mitigation in progress"
```

raj: cache restart completed. now checking 5xx rate.

chris: 5xxs dropping from 18% -> 3% over last 60s. latency recovering. great.

sofia: CS notified: initial mitigation helped, monitoring for 30m before closing.

emma: follow-up actions: 1) identify hot key cause 2) implement client-side rate limit/backoff 3) add runaway-key detection in metrics. i'll create tickets.

chris: handing back to raj for any follow-through infra changes. thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:

raj: i'm taking ownership for postmortem and cleanup. will post notes to #postmortems and link runbook updates. marking incident as acknowledged -> recovering.

pagerbot: incident update: status=acknowledged, owner=raj, note="recovering; postmortem assigned".

incident-bot: If anyone else has logs or customer notes, paste here. Closing thread in 30m unless new pages occur.
